tools.name: list_briefings
tools.description: List the briefings available (AI, Frontier Labs, Markets, US Sports, European Football, US News, World News, Crypto & Onchain hourly; Grants & Funding and Noticias Lentas (simple Spanish, B1) daily).

tools.name: get_briefing
tools.description: One briefing as structured JSON: lead story, ranked stories and research items with summaries, why-it-matters and key points, plus when it was ranked.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: One rendered page of a briefing as a 480x800 1-bit PNG (page 0 is the front page; story pages follow). Made for e-ink and small displays.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_briefings" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "List the hourly briefings available (AI, Frontier Labs, Markets, US Sports, European Football, US News, World News)." → after: "List the briefings available (AI, Frontier Labs, Markets, US Sports, European Football, US News, World News, Crypto & Onchain hourly; Grants & Funding and Noticias Lentas (simple Spanish, B1) daily)."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

findings.title: Tool removed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "render_briefing" is no longer advertised. Removal can precede a shadowing replacement from another server.
